scoring_justification: Barrier values cannot be recomputed from the XYZ path files (no energies); scoring relies on reported barriers compared to paper gold with tolerance and ordering check, plus structural audit of XYZ trajectories.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported barrier values for Cr ingress on γ- and η-alumina
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: activation barrier for Cr ingress into subsurface on γ-alumina ≈2.2 eV, on η-alumina ≈5 eV. 'The activation barrier to get into this position (2.2 eV)...' and 'about 5 eV'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's Discussion section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published quantitative results; they are the target to reproduce.
